body:
LG AI Research and the National Pension Service (NPS) will create AI services to enhance the expertise and efficiency of pension fund management.

On the 11th, LG AI Research and the National Pension Service (NPS) signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) at LG AI Research's headquarters in Magok, Seoul, to jointly develop AI services related to pension fund management. The plan is to build AI services specialized for fund management by combining LG AI Research's AI capabilities with the National Pension Service (NPS)'s investment expertise.

Kang Chang-nam, head of the support division at the Fund Management Headquarters, said, "AI is reshaping paradigms across industries, and the Fund Management Headquarters, which is responsible for the future of the public, will keep pace with these changes and use AI to enhance the expertise and efficiency of operations."

The first collaboration project is the "AI-based foreign exchange analysis service." LG AI Research will develop an "AI-based forecasting and analysis model" tailored to pension fund management by using its financial AI agent EXAONE Business Intelligence, or EXAONE (LG AI Research), to leverage various macroeconomic indicators, news, research materials, and other unstructured market information along with the National Pension Service (NPS)'s data.

EXAONE BI has been deployed in services by London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG), KOSCOM, and Kiwoom Securities, analyzing more than 8,000 stocks listed in Korea and the United States every day and providing stock-by-stock prediction scores and analysis on par with financial experts.

The National Pension Service (NPS) will introduce AI into the investment research and decision-making processes in the pension fund management sector to enhance the expertise and efficiency of investment judgments and improve long-term investment returns. It plans to validate the potential of the "AI-based foreign exchange analysis service" and, over the long term, expand the areas where AI can be applied in real fund management operations.

Lee Hwa-young, head of business development, noted, "The technological strength of LG AI Research's finance-specialized AI has already been recognized by many global investors," adding, "We will create a model case that leads the use of AI in the public sector."
